description: - Extract and interpret embedded file metadata with exiftool — EXIF GPS coordinates, camera make, model and serial, DateTimeOriginal and CreateDate timestamps, XMP and IPTC fields, and Office and PDF… Use when reading EXIF from a photo, checking who really wrote a document, dating a file, fingerprinting a camera or phone, or investigating provenance in JPEG, HEIC, RAW, MP4, DOCX, XLSX or PDF
